result_summary: Recovered the stale Prometeo mobile planner lane and emitted a dependency-aware local campaign without inventing a separate mobile product. The plan preserves the served Universal Host as byte owner, turns the one-message correction requirement into a deterministic page-thread claim/run/RETURN loop with concise same-thread execution projection, gates capability reuse on existing owners, specifies preserve-first falsification boundaries, and makes LOCAL-INTEGRATE the sequential successor only after all nine declared dependencies have exact qualifying RETURN plus matching terminal DONE.
material_advances: Converted a stale PLAN lane and an abandoned first recovery claim into a fresh append-only recovery lineage without overwriting earlier evidence.
Reconciled the UX audit's formerly missing Page Thread Bridge: later candidate bridge evidence shifts the frontier from bridge creation to causal wiring and local reconciliation.
Separated logical surface autonomy from product byte ownership, preventing a second mobile shell/app/page identity from being inferred from surface_id.
Defined four parallel planning lanes (authority/identity, causal thread loop, falsification, capability reuse) and one dependency-gated LOCAL-INTEGRATE successor.
Encoded the one-message correction path as capture -> deterministic identity -> atomic claim/dedup -> concise STARTED/progress -> durable RETURN -> same-surface result projection.

Emitted zero new opportunities because DISCOVER and live queue evidence already cover the frontier; REUSE returned while this run was active and names PLAN as the remaining same-surface dependency before local integration.
non_obvious_findings: The mobile bottleneck is lifecycle completion and causal reconciliation, not a new mobile layout or shell.
Coordination identity and served byte ownership are separate axes: a logical mobile surface can gain local stewardship while the single Universal Host remains the product owner.
Bridge/steward targeted tests are candidate evidence only and cannot be inflated into browser/device Human Acceptance.

At return preflight the recovered REUSE lane had itself reached durable RETURN and the public epoch compiled its DONE, leaving this PLAN lifecycle as the last same-surface precursor before dynamic local-integration readiness is recalculated.
